Action items: 
1) Can you confirm who on your side owns vendor onboarding & the typical SLA? (Is it Procurement, Finance, or Vendor Ops?)
2) Which commercial path do you prefer for the first 30/60 days: card prepay, invoice/PO, or marketplace?
3) I attached a short checklist of the common docs customers need — if you confirm, we can start the vendor packet flow immediately.

Attachments: vendor-onboarding-form.pdf (your form) 

If it's easiest, we're happy to temporarily accept card/prepay for the first invoice up to $50k while your vendor onboarding proceeds — we'll also start the vendor exception request on our side in case Finance needs an internal sign-off. Let me know and I can loop in Marissa and our finance lead to expedite.
